name: Azariah
overview: Azariah was a male Levite who served as a priest in the temple built by Solomon. He was a descendant of Zadok, a notable priestly line, and fulfilled his priestly duties during Solomon's reign. His role is specifically noted in the context of temple service.
namesAndTitles: The name Azariah means 'YHWH has helped,' reflecting a recognition of divine assistance. This meaning highlights the theocentric nature of his identity as a servant of God in the priesthood.
familyAndRelationships: Azariah is identified as a descendant of Zadok, establishing his priestly lineage. He is also noted as the son of Johanan and the father of Amariah, indicating a generational priestly family line. These relationships underscore his place within the Levitical priesthood.
scriptureSignificance: Azariah's significance lies in his role as a priest descended from Zadok, serving in the temple Solomon constructed. His priestly service represents the continuation of the Zadokite priesthood during a foundational period in Israel's history. Through his ministry, Azariah exemplifies faithfulness to God's covenantal worship practices as established in the temple.
